We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Fleet Officer

Job Location: Ogun

Job Summary


	The Fleet Officer is responsible for monitoring the real-time movement of trucks transporting company products from warehouses to customers and depots.
	The role ensures complete visibility of vehicles in transit, proactively identifies delays, route deviations, security risks, and operational issues, and coordinates timely interventions to ensure safe and on-time deliveries.


Key Responsibilities
Real-Time Monitoring:


	Monitor all trucks in transit using GPS tracking systems/fleet management platforms.
	Track truck locations, movement, speed, and estimated time of arrival (ETA).
	Monitor truck seals and delivery milestones where applicable.
	Ensure every dispatched truck remains visible until delivery is completed.


Transit Coordination:


	Maintain continuous communication with drivers and transport providers.
	Update warehouses, customer service, and sales teams on delivery progress.
	Escalate delays, breakdowns, accidents, security threats, or unauthorized stops.
	Support route optimization and recovery plans where required.


Incident Management:


	Immediately report truck diversion, hijacking, theft, accidents, or prolonged delays.
	Maintain incident logs and follow up until issues are resolved.
	Coordinate with Security, Truck providers, Logistics operations team.


Compliance:


	Ensure adherence to approved routes and journey management procedures.
	Monitor transporter compliance with company transportation standards..
	Coordinate pre-trip inspection for every truck before assigning shipment.
	Ensure GIT insurance for all transporters are valid and value per carriage meets the minimum standard.
	Verify adherence to safety and security protocols.


Reporting:


	Produce daily truck movement and delivery status reports.
	Document route deviations, detention time, and delivery exceptions.
	Maintain accurate records of communications and transit activities.
	Daily pan-Nigeria depot operations report.
	Daily Key Performance Indicator Report (KPI).


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Truck visibility rate.
	On-Time&amp; In-Full(OTIF).
	ETA accuracy.
	Incident response time.
	Route deviation resolution time.
	Delivery status update timeliness per sales area.
	Daily reporting accuracy.
	Rate of GIT compliance per/transporter.


Qualifications


	Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Computer Science, Accounting, or related field.
	2 &ndash; 4 years of experience in logistics, fleet monitoring, or transportation operations.


Skills:


	Knowledge of GPS and fleet management systems.
	Excellent communication.
	Strong analytical(excel)and problem-solving skills.
	Attention to detail.
	Ability to multitask.

Fleet Officer Job at Grand Oak Limited




        
    

        
        Grand Oak Limited (GOL) - We are the largest Manufacturer of SpiritsandWines, we believe our spirits should have character; an authenticity derived from where they are distilled, bottled and the philosophies of those who distil them.

There are many attributes that describe us resolute, self-sufficient, tough, hard-working, enduring, emotional, passionate, philosophical and engaging.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Fleet Officer

Job Location: Ogun

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Fleet Officer is responsible for monitoring the real-time movement of trucks transporting company products from warehouses to customers and depots.
	The role ensures complete visibility of vehicles in transit, proactively identifies delays, route deviations, security risks, and operational issues, and coordinates timely interventions to ensure safe and on-time deliveries.


Key Responsibilities
Real-Time Monitoring:


	Monitor all trucks in transit using GPS tracking systems/fleet management platforms.
	Track truck locations, movement, speed, and estimated time of arrival (ETA).
	Monitor truck seals and delivery milestones where applicable.
	Ensure every dispatched truck remains visible until delivery is completed.


Transit Coordination:


	Maintain continuous communication with drivers and transport providers.
	Update warehouses, customer service, and sales teams on delivery progress.
	Escalate delays, breakdowns, accidents, security threats, or unauthorized stops.
	Support route optimization and recovery plans where required.


Incident Management:


	Immediately report truck diversion, hijacking, theft, accidents, or prolonged delays.
	Maintain incident logs and follow up until issues are resolved.
	Coordinate with Security, Truck providers, Logistics operations team.


Compliance:


	Ensure adherence to approved routes and journey management procedures.
	Monitor transporter compliance with company transportation standards..
	Coordinate pre-trip inspection for every truck before assigning shipment.
	Ensure GIT insurance for all transporters are valid and value per carriage meets the minimum standard.
	Verify adherence to safety and security protocols.


Reporting:


	Produce daily truck movement and delivery status reports.
	Document route deviations, detention time, and delivery exceptions.
	Maintain accurate records of communications and transit activities.
	Daily pan-Nigeria depot operations report.
	Daily Key Performance Indicator Report (KPI).


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)


	Truck visibility rate.
	On-Time& In-Full(OTIF).
	ETA accuracy.
	Incident response time.
	Route deviation resolution time.
	Delivery status update timeliness per sales area.
	Daily reporting accuracy.
	Rate of GIT compliance per/transporter.


Qualifications


	Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain, Computer Science, Accounting, or related field.
	2 – 4 years of experience in logistics, fleet monitoring, or transportation operations.


Skills:


	Knowledge of GPS and fleet management systems.
	Excellent communication.
	Strong analytical(excel)and problem-solving skills.
	Attention to detail.
	Ability to multitask.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Applications Engineer - DrillBit

Ref ID: R165258
Job Location: Lagos

About The Role


	The Applications Engineer ensures Baker Hughes can deliver flawless execution through involvement in pre-planning, job execution, and post-job analysis.
	This position delivers a technical job program or application design that maximizes our opportunity to meet the job objectives in line with the contract terms and conditions.
	This position works seamlessly together with the Service Delivery Coordinators and other resources across organizational boundaries to ensure all aspects and constraints of the applications are understood and have been considered.


As an Applications Engineer, you will be responsible for


	Ensure compliance with manage the Job Cycle (MtJC) process
	Work with the assigned Service Delivery Coordinator/Salesperson to understand the client&rsquo;s well construction or production objectives as well as the commercial terms for Baker Hughes (i.e. outcome based contract, line item contract, etc.)

	Work together with all disciplines and stakeholders to ensure all aspects and constraints of the application and suggested products/services have been considered
	Design a job program, including risk mitigation plans and contingency plans, that can meet the client&rsquo;s objective(s), maximize revenue potential and ensure future job assignments for Baker Hughes

	Compare job as-planned versus job as-executed, document any lessons learned and develop recommendations for further improvements to procedures to ensure continuous improvement takes place
	Work on Field Incidents related to products/services
	Participate in Incident Investigations when required, ensuring the end to end process is considered, (including job planning, preparation, and execution), when determining incident root cause(s) alongside appropriate corrective actions
	Ensure timely incident management to enable fast customer issue resolution and cash collection
	Advise on product improvement opportunities for repetitive component/product failures&nbsp;
	Responsible for providing sales support and product application recommendations
	Product line specific responsibilities as applicable
	Handles special projects as required


To be successful in this role you will


	Bachelor&rsquo;s Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics
	Excellent leadership, interpersonal, influencing and planning skills
	Ability to be on call outside of normal business hours
	Ability to work in a global matrix organization
	Excellent communication and presentation skills
	Excellent organizational, analytical and problem solving skills
	Must have the ability to travel (potential for travel to rig sites, customer facilities, meetings, training, etc.)
	Significant operational experience
	Comfortable presenting in front of an audience of experienced peers
	Ability to manage, develop, coach, and mentor teams across organizational boundaries
	Ability to learn and use various computer tools to prepare data and visualizations for analysis
	Ability to work independently
	Must have completed NYSC.


Work in a way that works for you:
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:


	Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:


	Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
	Comprehensive private medical care options
	Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
	Tailored financial programs
	Additional elected or voluntary benefits

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Applications Engineer - DrillBit

Ref ID: R165258
Job Location: Lagos

	This position works seamlessly together with the Service Delivery Coordinators and other resources across organizational boundaries to ensure all aspects and constraints of the applications are understood and have been considered.

	Ensure compliance with manage the Job Cycle (MtJC) process
	Work with the assigned Service Delivery Coordinator/Salesperson to understand the client’s well construction or production objectives as well as the commercial terms for Baker Hughes (i.e. outcome based contract, line item contract, etc.)
	Perform offset job analysis and product/service specific engineering modelling calculations to understand application hazards and incident potential

	Accurately document any calculations/simulations/plan revision and/or changes during the project cycles for visibility to dependent teams and audit purposes

	Compare job as-planned versus job as-executed, document any lessons learned and develop recommendations for further improvements to procedures to ensure continuous improvement takes place

	Participate in Incident Investigations when required, ensuring the end to end process is considered, (including job planning, preparation, and execution), when determining incident root cause(s) alongside appropriate corrective actions
	Ensure timely incident management to enable fast customer issue resolution and cash collection
	Advise on product improvement opportunities for repetitive component/product failures 
	Responsible for providing sales support and product application recommendations
	Product line specific responsibilities as applicable

	Bachelor’s Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics

	Ability to be on call outside of normal business hours
	Ability to work in a global matrix organization

	Excellent organizational, analytical and problem solving skills

	Comfortable presenting in front of an audience of experienced peers
	Ability to manage, develop, coach, and mentor teams across organizational boundaries
	Ability to learn and use various computer tools to prepare data and visualizations for analysis
	Ability to work independently
	Must have completed NYSC.


Work in a way that works for you:
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:


	Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.


Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we must push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:


	Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
	Comprehensive private medical care options

	Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets.

Utility Manager Job at Grand Oak Limited




        
    

        
        Grand Oak Limited (GOL) - We are the largest Manufacturer of SpiritsandWines, we believe our spirits should have character; an authenticity derived from where they are distilled, bottled and the philosophies of those who distil them.

There are many attributes that describe us resolute, self-sufficient, tough, hard-working, enduring, emotional, passionate, philosophical and engaging.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Utility Manager

Job Location: Sango Ota, Ogun

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Supervise daily operations of all utility systems including boilers, compressors, chillers, generators, water treatment plants, and HVAC systems.
	Ensure continuous and efficient supply of utilities to support production activities.
	Monitor equipment performance and implement preventive and corrective maintenance schedules.
	Lead and coordinate a team of technicians and operators.
	Troubleshoot utility-related issues and implement timely solutions to minimize downtime.
	Maintain accurate records of utility consumption, maintenance activities, and system performance.
	Ensure compliance with safety regulations, environmental standards, and company policies.
	Support energy efficiency initiatives and cost reduction strategies.
	Liaise with external vendors and contractors for specialized maintenance or repairs.
	Participate in audits and inspections as required.


Requirements


	Educational Qualification: HND in Mechanical Engineering or any related Engineering discipline.
	Experience: Minimum of 3 years of experience in utility operations within an FMCG or manufacturing environment.
	Strong knowledge of industrial utility systems (steam, compressed air, water systems, refrigeration, power generation).
	Familiarity with maintenance planning and execution.
	Good leadership and team management skills.
	Basic knowledge of health, safety, and environmental practices.
	Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and maintenance management systems is an advantage.

Graphics Designer Job at Eni Brand Architect Limited




        
    

        
        EBA (Eni Brand Architect Limited) is a full-service creative, branding, and Public Relations (PR) agency based in Lagos, Nigeria. The agency positions itself as "architects of legacy," specializing in personal branding, brand storytelling, and strategic communications.

We are recruiting for the position below:

 Job Position: Graphics Designer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

            
    




	We’re looking for a creative Graphics Designer to help bring brand stories to life through visuals.
	At EBA, design isn’t just about looking good; it’s about building recognition and communicating value for personal brands and campaigns.
	This role is a chance to practice design in a fast-paced, branding-focused environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Design digital assets for social media, campaigns, presentations, and marketing materials.
	Creation of brand kits, pitch decks, and media kits for clients.
	Collaborate with the content and social media teams to ensure design aligns with copy and messaging.
	Maintain brand consistency across all visuals, following established guidelines.
	Quick-turnaround requests such as event flyers, reels thumbnails, and story templates.


Requirements


	Familiarity with design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Canva, or Figma.
	Strong eye for typography, layout, and color use.
	Interest in branding, digital marketing, and storytelling through visuals.
	Ability to manage time and meet deadlines.
	Open to feedback and eager to learn in a collaborative team.


What You’ll Gain


	Real portfolio pieces across campaigns, brand decks, and social media assets.
	Opportunity to learn how design fits into wider PR and branding strategies.
	Experience working on live client projects.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and portfolio to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
